rules.pass: A role that runs here is online under its supervisor.
rules.warn: A role is starting or stopping, runs without a supervisor, or has restarted 3 or more times and has run for less than 10 minutes.
rules.fail: A role that runs here is stopped, or its supervisor gave up on it.
rules.unknown: The roles, or a role's process row, could not be read, or no role that the run looks at is set up on this host.

advice.not-running: The {role} is not running. Start it with `heartwood {role} start`, then read its error log with `heartwood {role} log --error`. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#process-roles.
advice.errored: The supervisor gave up restarting the {role}. Read its error log with `heartwood {role} log --error`, fix the cause, then start it with `heartwood {role} start`. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#process-roles.
advice.changing: The {role} is starting or stopping. Run the doctor again in a minute.
advice.unsupervised: The {role} runs without a supervisor and stops when this terminal closes. Start it with `heartwood {role} start --daemon` or as a service. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#process-roles.
advice.restarting: The {role} restarted {restarts} times and has run for {minutes} minutes. Read its error log with `heartwood {role} log --error`. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#process-roles.

rules.skipped: This check is not in this release.

rules.pass: The relay runs, or it stopped without a start error.
rules.fail: The relay is stopped, and its error capture since its last start, or its log after its last start line, shows a start error, which is named.
rules.unknown: Neither the error capture nor the log could be read.
rules.skipped: This host does not run a relay.

advice.none: The relay shows no start error.
advice.p2p-in-use: The relay stopped at start: its P2P port {port} is already in use on this host. Find the other process with `ss -ltnp 'sport = :{port}'`, stop it or change `CORE_P2P_PORT`, then start the relay. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#relay-start-errors.
advice.p2p-cannot-listen: The relay stopped at start: it could not listen on its P2P address. Check `CORE_P2P_HOST` and `CORE_P2P_PORT`, then start the relay. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#relay-start-errors.
advice.api-in-use: The relay stopped at start: its API port {port} is already in use on this host. Find the other process with `ss -ltnp 'sport = :{port}'`, stop it or change `CORE_API_PORT`, then start the relay. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#relay-start-errors.
advice.api-cannot-listen: The relay stopped at start: it could not open its API on its configured address. Check `CORE_API_HOST` and `CORE_API_PORT`, then start the relay. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#relay-start-errors.
advice.version-floor: The relay stopped at start: the network's version floor refuses this release. Install the release named in the announcement, then start the relay. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#relay-start-errors.
advice.api-https: The relay stopped at start: `CORE_API_SSL` is set, which this release does not support. Remove it, then start the relay. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#relay-start-errors.
advice.config: The relay stopped at start: it refused its configuration. Read its error log with `heartwood relay log --error`, fix the setting it names, then start the relay. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#relay-start-errors.
advice.other: The relay stopped at start with an error the doctor does not sort. Read its error log with `heartwood relay log --error`. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#relay-start-errors.
